title: How AI Rebuilt This Blog: Blogger to Hugo in One Sitting
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: Say a preference once, and a good agent keeps enforcing it long after you have forgotten you said it - across 117 posts and counting.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how agents can internalize design preferences and apply them consistently across large numbers of artifacts without repeated instruction

quotes.text: the 22 review posts are proof that judgment calls still need a person
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that AI agents excel at classification and execution but humans remain essential for ambiguous edge cases and final decisions
